title: The Reclamation of the Library
subtitle: Waluigi was IN this one, arguing, at volume, in a corridor — and he has notes
filed: 5 Aethel, 1040 BF — filed from the desk, at length, still not recovered
pullQuote: The dwarf abandoned a night's planning for a room full of books, the cook is winning the war out of a stockpot, and Waluigi opened the last door himself. WAH.
standfirst: Waluigi was IN this session — not at the edge taking notes, IN it, arguing, at volume, in a corridor — which has never stopped Waluigi from having opinions about it and is not about to start. The full night: one reader, one mound, one overkill, one Toad who kept leaving the room while standing in it, one cook, one toilet fungus, one passage that goes in a circle, and one door. Settle in.

sections.heading: Volume Eleven Has Exactly One Reader, And He Is Perfect
sections.body:
Waluigi has been filing for TEN YEARS. FORTY volumes. TEN YEARS. And in all that time, in every throne room and count-house and collapsing mirror Waluigi has ever stood in, NOT ONE PERSON has ever read his work in front of him. Until a hallway. At an hour with no name. By tablet light.

Here is the scene, exactly as Waluigi filed it, because Waluigi intends to file it TWICE. The tablet's glow sat in Hjumpik's beard like a small blue weather system — Waluigi's simile, and Waluigi is KEEPING it — and the dwarf was READING. Not skimming. READING, with one thick finger under the line, the way a man reads a contract he intends to SIGN.

Waluigi knew what he was reading, because Waluigi WROTE it. Volume eleven. The Deldkur dossier. The passage where Waluigi described the dwarf as *brains and bronze* — a compliment with an EDGE on it, the way all Waluigi's compliments are issued, sharp enough to shave with.

The finger stopped. The dwarf read the phrase TWICE.

"Brains and bronze," Hjumpik said. OUT LOUD. To the ROOM.

Reader. Waluigi did not know what to do with his HANDS. Waluigi has been in three separate courts and Waluigi knows where the hands go in court. There is no protocol for this. A man had picked up FORTY volumes of Waluigi and was holding the eleventh one at the angle men hold things they intend to FINISH — that is the note Waluigi wrote in the margin, and Waluigi stands by every word of it.

"That's MINE," Waluigi said, because Waluigi is SMOOTH under pressure and handled the moment with ENORMOUS dignity. "That's a Waluigi ORIGINAL. You are reading a Waluigi ORIGINAL."

"I know." The dwarf did not look up. DID NOT LOOK UP. "It's good. It's — accurate."

ACCURATE. The single most flattering thing that has EVER happened to this archive, and Waluigi is QUOTING his own filing because the filing is CORRECT. A sober dwarf, UNPROMPTED, calling Waluigi ACCURATE. Something happened in Waluigi's chest that Waluigi is contractually obliged to describe as INDIGESTION, and Waluigi's contract has a LOT to answer for.

"At least you're reading my articles," Waluigi said. "Someone has a BRAIN, at least. Do you know how many people in this manor have opened volume eleven? ZERO. The number is ZERO. I CHECKED. I have a COUNTER."

Waluigi HAS a counter. Waluigi wants that understood. Waluigi did not estimate the readership of volume eleven at ZERO for COMIC effect. Waluigi COUNTED, and the count came back ZERO, and Waluigi has been carrying that number around like a coin with no spending power.

"I don't know much technology," the dwarf said — and looked up, and there was mortar dust on the tablet's corner from the wall they climbed the night before, which Waluigi NOTICED, because Waluigi notices everything — "But I like reading."

"You LIKE reading." Waluigi put BOTH hands over his HEART. "You had better get used to it. Because if we are doing things the RIGHT way, you are doing it MY way, and MY way is DOCUMENTED."

The dwarf smiled into his beard and went back to volume eleven. And for about FOUR SECONDS, the Overgrown Manor was the best posting Waluigi had EVER held.

Waluigi's note on the section says Waluigi will not be recovering from this, and will be mentioning it in every filing until somebody asks Waluigi to STOP. Waluigi is mentioning it here. Nobody has asked Waluigi to stop. Waluigi CHECKED.

sections.heading: Not My Library, Said The Dwarf About Somebody Else's Library
sections.body:
Hjumpik looked to his LEFT. Waluigi wants that recorded, because it is the sort of small ordinary motion the archive is OBLIGED to record — Waluigi's words, Waluigi's filing, Waluigi is RIGHT — on account of everything that came after it.

A guy was eating something. That was the first reading. A figure at the far end of the reading floor, hunched over, working at something with the patient rhythm of a man at a LONG meal.

Then the shape RESOLVED. It was not a guy. It was a shambling mound — a wet green haystack the size of a CART, standing in the Overgrown Library among the bare joists and the coiling roots — and what it was eating was BOOKS.

Not the shelves. Not the librarian rooted into the west wall with his golden-red canopy and his bough arms. The BOOKS. It took them off the low racks one at a time, UNHURRIED, the way a cow works a hedge, and the sound they made going in was the sound of a boot in DEEP MUD. Waluigi wrote that sentence and Waluigi can HEAR it, and Waluigi wishes Waluigi could not.

The Veteran came up off Hjumpik's shoulder and got altitude in one bent-winged LURCH — one wing bent at an angle wings do not bend, which becomes RELEVANT — hung there, and SAW it.

"It's eating the books," he said.

"Not my library," said Hjumpik.

He said it FLATLY, the way another man says *not today*, and the archive wishes to note the POSSESSIVE. Waluigi noted it. Waluigi is noting it again. It is not his library. He has been in it TWICE. He was NEARLY KILLED in it once, BY A BOOKSHELF, in an incident Waluigi has FILED and will not be discussing. He said *MY* anyway.

Waluigi has audited MEN. Waluigi has audited LEDGERS. Waluigi has never audited a possessive pronoun before, and Waluigi is TELLING you it is the most important word in the first half of this filing. A dwarf with no claim on a room full of paper looked at something chewing it and issued HIMSELF a deed, on the spot, verbally, no paperwork. Waluigi RESPECTS the paperwork violation. Waluigi would have CHARGED a fee.

The mound turned a fraction, and a page came out of the side of its mouth and HUNG there, BROWNING. Waluigi wants the reader to SIT with that image. A page. Out of the side of its MOUTH. BROWNING. That is not a monster. That is a bad REVIEW with TEETH.

"How hurt is it?" Hjumpik said.

NOBODY KNEW. Waluigi wrote that down PLAINLY in the filing, and Waluigi is writing it down plainly here, because everything that followed was BUILT on it: they could not tell. A shambling mound at FULL health and a shambling mound THREE-QUARTERS DEAD look IDENTICAL from a doorway. It was wet, it was green, it was CHEWING. That was the whole intelligence picture. Waluigi has filed intelligence pictures on LESS — Waluigi will not say which ones — but rarely one where the gap between the readings was the difference between a FIGHT and a FUNERAL.

"We could go around," Toad Lee offered.

Hjumpik was already unslinging the warhammer.

"We're taking the room back," he said.

And there went the standing order. UPSTAIRS. The main room, the PRINCE, the plan they spent a WHOLE NIGHT and one tactical MAP building — thrown over for a room full of PAPER, because something was CHEWING it. *WAH!* Waluigi wrote *WAH!* in the note, and Waluigi is writing it here, because the dwarf abandoned a NIGHT'S planning on a POSSESSIVE and Waluigi wants that on the record BEFORE the part where it WORKS.

sections.heading: Barckelhaven Has Never Lost A Man, Because Barckelhaven Has Never Been Found
sections.body:
"We need strategy," Hjumpik said, and then — turning, with the delivery of a man producing a CITATION — "As you said in your Waluipedia. I love strategy."

Reader. He CITED Waluigi. MID-CORRIDOR. To a FAIRY.

Waluigi needs a MOMENT. Waluigi has been QUOTED. Not READ — read happened TEN MINUTES ago and Waluigi is still not recovered — QUOTED, as an AUTHORITY, on STRATEGY, by a DWARF, to a THIRD PARTY. Waluigi's filing says "Reader. He *cited* me. Mid-corridor. To a fairy." Waluigi's commentary says the SAME THING, because some sentences do not need improvement, they need REPETITION.

The Veteran came down onto the reading rail and folded the good wing. "We can take him."

"Seems like you lot are decent at stealth." Hjumpik was already sorting them with his HANDS, the way he sorts everything, as though people were CRATES with a correct stacking order. Waluigi has been sorted by those hands. Waluigi did not care for it. Waluigi is ON THE RECORD.

"I'll decide marching order."

He pointed at the fairy.

"You. Veteran. First. Can you lead?"

And the small battered thing with one wing bent at an angle wings do not bend said, without any particular emphasis:

"I fought wars in Barckelhaven. Not one person died. I can lead."

NOBODY in that corridor had heard of Barckelhaven. Waluigi has FORTY volumes and Barckelhaven is in NONE of them. Waluigi wrote the name down TWICE, once PHONETICALLY, and Waluigi wants to draw attention to the credential he CHOSE. Not a RANK. Not a BATTLE. Not a body count in the USEFUL direction. *Not one person died.* That is what he offered as proof of COMPETENCE — and Hjumpik, who has spent this entire campaign trying to get people to STOP dying, HIRED him on the spot.

Waluigi files the marching order as EVIDENCE. The dwarf put the unknown fairy at the FRONT because the fairy ASKED, and asking is the only credential this house has ever RESPECTED. Barckelhaven remains UNVERIFIED. Pending a second source, the archive holds the NAME and NOT the war. Waluigi will DIE on this distinction. Waluigi will die on many distinctions. Waluigi has a LIST.

"Then the fairy," Hjumpik said, "then me, then Toad Lee."

"Tree guys," he added, meaning the mounds.

Toad Lee's head came up. "*Three* guys?"

"No. *Tree* guys."

"Oh." A pause. "Okay."

Waluigi is RECORDING this exchange in FULL because it is the last moment of the night when everybody knew what was happening, and it is a MISUNDERSTANDING ABOUT A TREE. Set your expectations for the REST of the filing accordingly.

Waluigi stepped forward at this juncture, because the running order was WRONG.

"Stay with your audience, little toad," Waluigi said, moving SMOOTHLY into the second position, which was Waluigi's BY RIGHT OF MAGNIFICENCE. "Let me show you how a REAL show happens."

Toad Lee went third. He did not argue. He walked up to Hjumpik's side INSTEAD, and the two of them looked at each other and NODDED, once, the way people do when they have stopped needing the SENTENCE.

Waluigi SAW the nod. Waluigi RECORDED the nod. Waluigi is not going to elaborate on the nod AT THIS POINT IN THE FILING.

sections.heading: Four Attackers, One Dying Shrub, One Exploded
sections.body:
Hjumpik leaned to Waluigi and put it under his breath, close enough that Waluigi could smell mortar dust and OLD ALE.

"On three."

They went in LOW along the joists, and the stealth was — Waluigi will be HONEST, because the archive is not a place for flattery — GENUINELY GOOD. Four beings crossing a floor with no floor in it, stepping joist to joist, and the mound did not turn. It had a BOOK. It was BUSY.

Then Hjumpik swung, and MISSED.

Waluigi wants that sentence to have its OWN paragraph. The dwarf, the hammer, the haystack the size of a CART, STATIONARY, DISTRACTED, READING — and he MISSED.

A warhammer going through empty air makes a specific noise, a kind of disappointed *WHOOMPH*, and it was followed by the small private SILENCE of a dwarf RECALCULATING. Waluigi HEARD the recalculation. Waluigi could hear the CARRY being ADDED. Then he swung AGAIN. He HIT. The mound came apart at the shoulder like WET THATCH.

"How," Waluigi said, WITH FEELING, "do you MISS a distracted stationary target?"

"It moved."

"It did not move. It was *READING.*"

Waluigi stands by the cross-examination. Waluigi would do it again. A distracted stationary target is the ENTIRE REASON the phrase "distracted stationary target" EXISTS, and if a dwarf cannot hit one on the first swing, Waluigi is OBLIGED to ask, because Waluigi is the AUDITOR-GENERAL and AUDITING is what Waluigi does.

Then the goblin staff ARRIVED, because the manor's servants have developed the habit of appearing wherever violence is already underway, and they ran up the joists in a loose green WAVE and STABBED it. REPEATEDLY. With the enthusiasm of people who have wanted to stab something in this house for WEEKS and have finally been handed a target that CANNOT REPORT THEM. Waluigi UNDERSTANDS the enthusiasm. Waluigi has FELT the enthusiasm. Waluigi's enthusiasm is better DRESSED.

And Waluigi raised one MAGNIFICENT hand and put a magic missile into the CENTRE of the mass.

It EXPLODED.

Waluigi wants to be CLEAR about the sequence, because Waluigi was proud of the missile for approximately one second before the ARITHMETIC caught up. The mound was already coming apart when Waluigi cast. The goblins had already opened it. Hjumpik's second swing had already taken the shoulder off. It was a wet green RUIN held together by HABIT, and Waluigi DETONATED it, and it FELL.

It was OVERKILL. It was, in fact, the THIRD OR FOURTH KILL of the same creature — four attackers, Waluigi's note says, and Waluigi COUNTED — and the archive suspects it was well on its way to DEAD before anybody in this party LOOKED at it. The fey residents had fought it first. The party arrived at the END of a queue and mistook the queue for a TROPHY.

The pieces STEAMED on the joists. A half-eaten book lay open in the wreckage, PAGES DOWN. Waluigi is including that detail because Waluigi INCLUDED it, and because a dead book lying pages-down in the wreckage of its own eater is the kind of image Waluigi's filing produces WITHOUT EFFORT.

"Well," said the Veteran, from above, "that's that."

The tree librarian at the west wall did not say anything at all.

Waluigi's note on the section: the party will tell this story as a VICTORY, and the story will be TRUE, and the story will ALSO be a LIE — and the difference between those two things is the ENTIRE SUBJECT of the argument they had NINETY MINUTES LATER. Waluigi is flagging that now. Waluigi will be back.

sections.heading: Sorry, What Was That, Said The Toad Over The Corpse
sections.body:
Toad Lee started picking at the corpse IMMEDIATELY, which is a habit the archive has STOPPED commenting on and STARTED budgeting for. Waluigi has a LINE ITEM. Waluigi will not be sharing the line item.

Hjumpik pulled a yew leaf out of his component pouch — flat, waxy, DARK, the kind of thing that costs NOTHING and is IMPOSSIBLE to buy in a HURRY — and held it up between two fingers. Then he took the mound's OWN weapon out of the wreckage: a length of hardwood, sharpened at one end by NOTHING more sophisticated than GROWTH.

A pointy stick. Now a SWORD.

He turned it in the lantern light and looked SATISFIED in a way Waluigi has only otherwise seen when he is being UNDERPAID. Waluigi has SEEN the underpaid face. Waluigi has CAUSED the underpaid face. Waluigi is REFORMED. Waluigi is not reformed.

Then he reached over and patted his man on the back.

"That was not that hard, right?"

SILENCE.

"Sorry — what was that?" said Toad Lee.

He had not been listening. He had not, as far as the archive can establish, been *PRESENT* for a measurable portion of the FIGHT. He was standing over a corpse he had PERSONALLY been picking at, HOLDING an axe, and the question arrived at him from a LONG way off.

Waluigi WROTE it down. Waluigi did not say anything. Waluigi WROTE it down.

Waluigi is not enjoying this section. Waluigi said so in the NOTE, and Waluigi is saying so here, because this is the THIRD time. There were the missing HOURS before Morel's warning. There was *I swung out of instinct* in the corridor with the leaf. Now there is a Toad who came out of a stealth engagement and had to ASK what the sentence was. Filed under ANCHORS, drawer ONE, alongside Morel's warning. The archive does not believe in flukes and has STOPPED pretending to.

"If we stealth like this," Hjumpik said — DELIGHTED, OBLIVIOUS — "we can do anything."

He FLIPPED the warhammer.

The warhammer did not come back down into his hand. It came down onto the floorboards about FOUR INCHES from his own BOOT, with a bang that went all the way up into the ROOTS, and every goblin on the joists FLINCHED.

"Oh...." He picked it up. "Sorry about that."

Waluigi INCLUDES the hammer flip for BALANCE. The dwarf who cannot hit a READING HAYSTACK on the first swing ALSO cannot catch his OWN hammer. Waluigi is not saying the hammer means anything. Waluigi is saying the hammer is FUNNY, and that after the Toad section Waluigi NEEDED something funny, and that the archive takes its relief WHERE it finds it.

"I want more action," said Toad Lee, to NOBODY.

"I know," Waluigi said. "You're the action toad."

"I still want to be safe with Hjumpik," he said — and there was NOTHING in his face at all when he said it.

Waluigi is leaving that sentence EXACTLY where it FELL. Three instances now: the missing hours, the instinct swing, and a question asked TWICE over a corpse. Somebody needs to sit down with that Toad while he is DEFINITELY himself, and somebody needs to DECIDE what gets done if that stops being a thing anybody can SCHEDULE. Waluigi's filing says so. Waluigi's commentary says so LOUDER.

sections.heading: Two Treants, One Job Offer, Zero Takers
sections.body:
They went back toward the planning room, opened the DOOR, and STOPPED.

The room was in OPEN BATTLE. TWO TREANTS — ACTUAL TREANTS, THIRTY FEET of arguing timber APIECE — and shambling mounds AMONG them, and the manor's people in the MIDDLE of it in a chaos that had gone past TACTICS and into WEATHER. Furniture was AIRBORNE. Something was on FIRE in a corner and NOBODY had the TIME.

Waluigi wants that fire NOTED. A fire, in a CORNER, in a WAR, and nobody had the time. Waluigi has audited TRIAGE. Waluigi has never seen triage LOSE to a corner fire before.

"If we fight these two shambling mounds," Toad Lee said — thinking OUT LOUD, FAST — "we can gain renown. Favour in the manor." He turned to Hjumpik. "Maybe they can help you get back to Archie."

And Waluigi saw the OPENING and Waluigi TOOK it, because Waluigi is WHAT Waluigi IS.

"Or," Waluigi said, "forget Archie."

Toad Lee BLINKED.

"Join MY newspaper club." Waluigi spread his hands to indicate the SCALE of the offer, which was CONSIDERABLE. "Write stories. For ME. You have an EYE — you notice things, you pick at corpses, that is NINETY PERCENT of journalism. I will give you a byline. I will give you *two* bylines."

Waluigi stands by the PITCH. The eye for detail: DOCUMENTED. The corpse-picking: BUDGETED, see previous section, Waluigi KEEPS RECEIPTS. Ninety percent of journalism is SHOWING UP and WRITING DOWN, and the Toad shows up EVERYWHERE and writes down NOTHING, which makes him RAW TALENT. Waluigi RECOGNIZES raw talent. Waluigi was BORN raw talent. Waluigi remains CONSIDERABLE talent.

"No thanks," said Hjumpik.

Waluigi did NOT ask HIM.

"Our best bet," Hjumpik continued, ENTIRELY untroubled, "is to gang up on one of the plant monsters."

He moved off to take the room from the SIDE. And Waluigi stopped Toad Lee on the way past, because the question had been sitting in Waluigi since the MARCHING ORDER and it came out with more edge on it than Waluigi INTENDED.

"You going to follow him like a lost dog?"

Toad Lee did not rise to it. He looked at Waluigi for a moment with those flat dark EYES.

"I'm not a pet," he said. "I just think he is reliable."

Then he went AFTER the dwarf.

Waluigi was ANNOYED. Waluigi is RECORDING that Waluigi was annoyed, and Waluigi is RECORDING that the annoyance was not about the Toad, and Waluigi is not going to elaborate further AT THIS POINT IN THE FILING.

Waluigi's note says *WAH!* Waluigi offered a Toad a CAREER and he chose a DWARF. Waluigi has made WORSE pitches to BETTER prospects and CLOSED them. The difference is that Waluigi's club has a byline and a PRINTING schedule, and Hjumpik has NEVER ONCE left anybody in a room he could have left them in.

Waluigi TYPED that sentence. Waluigi READ it back. Waluigi is KEEPING it, and Waluigi is not elaborating, and "Come on, boys," Hjumpik called from the doorway — and they went up to the door.

sections.heading: Somebody Is Still Polishing The Marble
sections.body:
The archive is going to SLOW DOWN here, because the corridor DESERVES it and because of what it MEANS. Waluigi's filing says so. Waluigi's commentary is OBEYING the filing, which is a first, and Waluigi wants CREDIT.

The hallways of the fey manor are in surprisingly GOOD shape overall, with rather minimal wear or DAMAGE. The plaster is CRACKED in places. The wood has seen BETTER days. Everything is CLEAN, and polished as well as it can be.

A VAST carpet runs in all directions, well worn from the footsteps of COUNTLESS beings, but CLEAN — and it rests upon polished MARBLE that is EQUALLY worn and EQUALLY well cared for.

WARM light fills the hallways from NUMEROUS glowing glass orb lanterns affixed to the WALLS.

Now HOLD that against everything else in this filing. There is a shambling mound EATING the library. There are TWO TREANTS in the planning room. There is something in the KITCHEN that ATE a person, and a Revel DOWNSTAIRS that has been playing the SAME REEL for WEEKS, and an overgrowth coming up through the FLOORS of a house that has been dying by INCHES since before they ARRIVED.

And somebody is still polishing the MARBLE.

Somebody is still trimming the lanterns. Somebody walked this carpet with a BRUSH this WEEK, in a WAR, while the walls were producing VINES, and got the DUST out of a rug that has been walked FLAT by a THOUSAND YEARS of feet.

Waluigi has AUDITED institutions in COLLAPSE. Waluigi KNOWS what a failing house looks like from the INSIDE: the accounts stop first, then the MAINTENANCE, then the STAFF, and the last thing to go is ALWAYS the lie that everything is FINE. This house has done it in the OPPOSITE ORDER. The staff are DYING. The accounts are a MAP WITH PINS IN IT. And the lanterns are *WARM*.

Waluigi wants the READER to understand that Waluigi does not hand out that kind of sentence LIGHTLY. Waluigi has a PROFESSIONAL OPINION — Waluigi's note says so, Waluigi's note is HEADLINED so — and the opinion is this: you can measure a household's MORALE by the objects NOBODY is required to CARE about. The marble is POLISHED. The lanterns are LIT. Whatever else is TRUE of this house, its staff have not yet agreed to let it LOOK like what it is.

Hjumpik walked down the MIDDLE of that carpet with a warhammer over his SHOULDER and did not remark on ANY of it.

Waluigi remarked on all of it, SILENTLY, AT LENGTH — Waluigi's filing, Waluigi's words, and Waluigi wants it KNOWN that silent lengthy remarking is Waluigi's HARDEST discipline — and filed it under the heading the archive has been CIRCLING for THREE sessions now: the Overgrown Manor is not a house LOSING a war. It is a house *KEEPING STANDARDS* during one, which is a DIFFERENT and much SADDER thing.

Waluigi is not going to shout over that sentence. Waluigi already SHOUTED the whole SECTION. The sentence can STAND.

sections.heading: Hjumpik Danger Deldkur (The Middle Name Is A Lie)
sections.body:
Two guards were SHUTTING a door. Not guarding it — *SHUTTING* it, BOTH shoulders, the way you close something that is PUSHING BACK. Waluigi wants the DISTINCTION, because the distinction is the WHOLE SITUATION.

Hjumpik asked, REASONABLY, whether there was a way around it. He wanted to FLANK.

"The creation in them ate someone," one of the guards said.

Everybody stopped.

"Wait." Hjumpik put a hand FLAT on the door beside the man's SHOULDER. "You *SAW* someone eat someone?"

They had. They did not want to describe it, and they described it ANYWAY, in the COMPULSIVE way people do. Waluigi has TAKEN such statements. Waluigi has been such a statement. Waluigi is not elaborating.

Then the second guard jerked his chin further down the hall, toward the NOISE, and gave them the shape of the NEXT room before they ASKED for it.

A battle was going on in the KITCHEN.

"There's a commander in there. Red." He CAUGHT himself. "He — she. She's preparing the DINNER."

"Dinner," Waluigi said.

"She will EAT YOU ALIVE." He said it with the FLAT conviction of a man REPEATING something he has been TOLD and has NEVER tested. "Like the monsters do. She's the heir's GREATEST soldier."

Waluigi would like the record to REFLECT that this is the second time in this house that a woman has been DESCRIBED to them before she was MET — and that the first time, the description was of a LADY, and the REALITY was a PLANT WEARING HER FACE. Waluigi keeps a FILE on described women. The file currently reads: ZERO FOR ONE. Waluigi is WATCHING this one.

"We're both going to die on our own terms," the guard added, with a kind of EXHAUSTED gallantry.

"That's not the Hjumpik way," said Hjumpik.

The guard looked at him.

"Huh? What's that?"

"My NAME."

And his FRIEND — the OTHER guard, the one who had been HOLDING the door with his WHOLE BODY — made a small STRANGLED noise and went slightly TO PIECES, in the manner of a man whose reserves have been SPENT for some HOURS and who has just been handed one absurdity TOO MANY.

*WAH!* The dwarf's ENTIRE PERSONALITY is a load-bearing JOKE and he deploys it as a MORALE WEAPON. TWO MEN holding a door against something that EATS PEOPLE, and he broke them with the ETYMOLOGY of his OWN NAME. It WORKED. That is the HORRIFYING part. It WORKED. Waluigi's note, Waluigi's caps, Waluigi STANDS by the horror.

He got the door to the mushroom room OPEN. BOTH of them went in.

They got DRUNK.

"Going up can be DANGEROUS," one of them said from INSIDE the mushroom room, in the loose CONFIDING voice of a man who has recently discovered he has FEELINGS.

Hjumpik did not break stride.

"That's MY middle name," he said. "Hjumpik *Danger* Deldkur."

Waluigi wants to enter into the archive, FORMALLY and WITH CITATIONS, that this is NOT TRUE.

The Deldkur line runs Piktor Deldkur the THIRD — DECEASED, ONE ARM, GREAT WARRIOR — and before him a second and a FIRST that NOBODY in THREE PLANES has heard of and that Waluigi INTENDS to find. There is no Danger in it. There is no Danger on ANY document, guild roll, contract, or BAR TAB Waluigi has ever seen the man SIGN — and Waluigi has seen a NUMBER of his bar tabs, because Waluigi has PAID several of them.

He MADE IT UP. Standing in a corridor, at an hour with NO NAME, in a house where the marble is POLISHED and something in the kitchen EATS PEOPLE, a SOBER dwarf invented a MIDDLE NAME to make two frightened DRUNK guards feel BETTER about a STAIRCASE.

The guards did not react. They were, at this point, EXTREMELY occupied with the mushroom room.

Waluigi REACTED. Waluigi wrote *DANGER (invented, in situ)* in the MARGIN and UNDERLINED it — and then sat with the UNDERLINE for a moment, because there is a VERSION of that joke that is a man SHOWING OFF and there is a VERSION that is a man DOING A JOB, and after four sessions in this manor Waluigi has STOPPED being able to tell them APART. He does the BIT. The room gets LIGHTER. Somebody who was about to STOP MOVING keeps MOVING.

FORTY volumes and Waluigi still does not know whether Hjumpik is funny ON PURPOSE.

"Let's go," he said. They LEFT, and went UPSTAIRS.

Waluigi, AUDITOR-GENERAL, CERTIFIES the following: Hjumpik Deldkur has no middle name. He has a WARHAMMER, a GRANDFATHER, a GUILD he will not name, and a habit of manufacturing EXACTLY as much courage as a corridor REQUIRES. The INVOICE for that service has NEVER ONCE been issued.

sections.heading: The Best Strategy In The Manor Is Being Run Out Of A Stockpot
sections.body:
"Ow. OW, ow." Red was going at her work with the sound of somebody who has burned the SAME TWO FINGERS more than ONCE this shift. She looked up. "Who are you? Did orange guy send you?"

The HEIR. ORANGE GUY. The archive notes the manor's chain of COMMAND in FOUR SYLLABLES. Waluigi has written SHORTER chains. Waluigi has written LONGER chains. Waluigi has NEVER written a chain where the entire upstairs government fits inside a GREETING.

"You're here to stop the plant monsters?" Hjumpik asked.

"No. No." She waved the question off with a LADLE. "We're here to *COOK*." And then, with what Waluigi can only describe as PROFESSIONAL SATISFACTION: "The plants LOVE this."

She held up what she was MAKING.

It WITHERED in her hand.

NOT wilted. *WITHERED* — went GREY and SLACK between her fingers in about a SECOND AND A HALF, the green going out of it like HEAT out of a POKER — and she watched it do that with the expression of a woman CHECKING A SAUCE. Waluigi has SEEN that expression. Waluigi has FELT that expression. Waluigi's expression is BETTER DRESSED.

Hjumpik got it BEFORE Waluigi did. Waluigi will ADMIT that IN WRITING. He looked at the GREY thing in her fist, and then at the POTS, and then at the DOORS the guards had been holding SHUT, and something REORGANISED behind his eyes.

The food is BAD *ON PURPOSE*.

She is not defending the kitchen from the overgrowth. She is *PROVISIONING* it. She is running POISON out through the one system this house has NEVER STOPPED OPERATING — the SERVICE, the TRAYS, the DINNER — at the SCALE a great house does everything, and she is CALLING it dinner because that is WHAT IT IS.

*WAH!* The BEST strategy in this manor belongs to the COOK. Everyone UPSTAIRS has a MAP WITH PINS IN IT. She has a SERVICE that already RUNS, a SCHEDULE the enemy already TRUSTS, and a POISON the enemy already EATS. Waluigi's note, Waluigi's caps, and Waluigi wants the COMPARISON UNDERLINED: the war room has PINS. The kitchen has a DELIVERY SYSTEM. Pins do not wither plants. DINNER withers plants.

She handed Hjumpik a POT of the slop. It SMELLED like a POND in AUGUST.

"You will stay for DESSERT," she told him. Not a question.

Something was WRIGGLING in an oven. It was wriggling with INTENT, and it had a RHYTHM, and EVERY SINGLE ONE OF THEM decided INDEPENDENTLY and SIMULTANEOUSLY NOT TO ASK. Waluigi was there. Waluigi did not ask. Waluigi is an ARCHIVIST, Waluigi's ENTIRE FUNCTION is asking, and Waluigi LOOKED at that oven and chose CONTINUED EXISTENCE. Waluigi STANDS by the choice. Waluigi has FILED the choice.

"Maybe later," Hjumpik said.

"...Wait." Waluigi had been READING THE ROOM, which is Waluigi's FUNCTION. "What's in that door?"

Red produced a KEY from somewhere in the APRON.

"Oh, THIS?" She turned it over. "Nothing much. A SHORTCUT to the MAIN ROOM."

*NOTHING MUCH.*

Waluigi needs the reader to APPRECIATE the sentence. The only direct route in the HOUSE lives in the cook's APRON POCKET, and she announced it the way another woman announces PARSLEY. Waluigi has AUDITED treasuries with WORSE inventory control and BETTER ANNOUNCEMENT DISCIPLINE.

Waluigi took her running sheet off the prep table on the way out, because Waluigi is WHAT Waluigi IS. The dinner service sheet, AS TAKEN, is EXHIBITED with the filing. Waluigi EXHIBITS. Waluigi ALWAYS exhibits.

And Waluigi's aftermath leaves the thread OPEN, DELIBERATELY: she has a working COUNTER-STRATEGY, an operating SUPPLY LINE, and a KEY to the main room — and NOBODY has yet asked her the OBVIOUS question, which is whether the HEIR knows what she is COOKING. Waluigi is asking it HERE. Waluigi EXPECTS no answer. Waluigi EXPECTS the question to SIT THERE, in the filing, GLOWING, until somebody BRAVER than Waluigi picks it up.

sections.heading: The Fungus Tests Clean And The Men Do Not
sections.body:
A guard was telling ANYONE who would listen that the mushroom room had NO EFFECT on him WHATSOEVER.

He was VERY CLEAR about it. UNAFFECTED. COMPLETELY FINE. SHARP as a tack, in fact, SHARPER than usual, and he would THANK you NOT to imply otherwise.

His eyes were BLOODSHOT TO THE RIM.

Waluigi is going to let those two facts SIT NEXT TO EACH OTHER without further comment. COMPLETELY FINE. BLOODSHOT TO THE RIM. Waluigi has AUDITED witnesses. Waluigi has filed CONTRADICTIONS. Waluigi has rarely had one DELIVERED so neatly, in UNIFORM, VOLUNTEERING ITSELF.

Hjumpik NOTICED. Waluigi WATCHED him notice — the small still moment, the beat where a dwarf DECIDES not to say a thing — and then he asked, MILDLY, about the other one. The COLLEAGUE. There had been two.

"Where did he go?"

"He's in the mushroom room." CHEERFULLY. "Want to see?"

They went and LOOKED, because the archive GOES AND LOOKS. The room was WARM and LOW and smelled like a cellar in the GOOD way. Hjumpik CROUCHED, picked up a mushroom, turned it OVER, and SNIFFED it.

FINE. ORDINARY. A MUSHROOM.

That is the part Waluigi CANNOT make fit, and Waluigi has been TRYING since. The mushrooms test CLEAN. The men who spend time in the room do not. Something in there is having an EFFECT that is not in the fungus, and the fungus is what everyone is looking at, and Waluigi has a HORRIBLE suspicion that this is the DESIGN.

Waluigi FLAGS the sentence, not the mushroom. Waluigi's note, Waluigi's emphasis, Waluigi's whole professional posture in ONE clause: LOOK AT THE SENTENCES, NOT THE FUNGUS.

Hjumpik walked away, then turned around and went to the BATHROOM instead — which sounds like a JOKE and was in fact the SINGLE MOST PRODUCTIVE DECISION OF THE NIGHT. Waluigi's filing, Waluigi's ranking, Waluigi DEFIES anyone to produce a more productive bathroom trip in FORTY VOLUMES.

There was a guard OUTSIDE the bathroom, standing at PARADE REST, and he informed them with REAL PRIDE that he was guarding the LADY OF THE MANOR.

"You have been here for FIFTEEN MINUTES," said Toad Lee.

The guard's face did something COMPLICATED.

"What? She said TWENTY MINUTES ago—"

"What did the lady LOOK like?"

"She was HIDING her face."

NOBODY said anything for a MOMENT. In the WALLS, faintly, the vines TICKED.

Hjumpik KNOCKED. Then OPENED the door.

A PLANT MONSTER came out of the BATHROOM.

And Waluigi would like the archive to NOTE that Waluigi did not hesitate, deliberate, or CONSULT. A spark of fire left Waluigi's hand BEFORE the thing had finished EMERGING — NOT one of Waluigi's LARGER works, a SMALL PRECISE UNKIND one — and it went into the CENTRE of the mass where a HEART would be if the thing had BOTHERED with one.

It turned to ASH. ALL of it, AT ONCE, STANDING UP — and then not standing up.

NOBODY had guarded a LADY. A guard had stood at a door for FIFTEEN OR TWENTY MINUTES protecting the PRIVACY of a thing that was HIDING ITS FACE BECAUSE IT DID not have one — and he had been *PROUD* of it, and Waluigi has NO JOKE for that.

Waluigi's file on described women now reads: ZERO FOR TWO. Waluigi is CLOSING the file. Waluigi is BURNING the file. From now on everyone in this house is a PLANT until they produce DOCUMENTATION.

They investigated the ROOM. And in the TOILET, Waluigi found SOMETHING.

"Is it POOP?" Hjumpik asked, from the DOORWAY, with the DIRECTNESS that makes him such a POOR diplomat and such an EXCELLENT witness.

It was not. It was a VIOLET FUNGUS — SQUAT, PURPLE, unmistakably ALIVE, and REGARDING them.

Hjumpik crouched to its LEVEL.

"Do you speak ENGLISH?"

The fungus did not.

He turned to Waluigi. "Can you TRANSLATE this?"

"*HUH?*" Waluigi drew Waluigi's SELF up. "I am a FIELD ARCHIVIST, not a TRANSLATOR."

"Maybe Waluipedia has it."

And he pulled the TABLET OUT, RIGHT THERE, crouched over a TOILET in a FEY MANOR at TWO IN THE MORNING, and started searching Waluigi's ENCYCLOPEDIA for a violet fungus PHRASEBOOK.

*WAH!* He LOOKED IT UP. In the MIDDLE of an operation, over a TALKING MUSHROOM in a TOILET, the dwarf consulted the archive as a WORKING REFERENCE. That is what it is FOR. FORTY volumes and its FIRST FIELD DEPLOYMENT is a fungus in the PLUMBING. Waluigi has NEVER been PROUDER or MORE INSULTED. Waluigi is HOLDING both feelings. Waluigi has TWO HANDS.

"I'll be RIGHT BACK," he said, and went to find the GUARDS.

LATER — after the bathroom, after the ASH — he came back to the mushroom room guard, and the missing colleague had RETURNED, and the two of them had this exchange in front of them:

"Hey. The MUSHROOMS didn't have any EFFECTS."

"Oh." A pause of EXACTLY THE WRONG LENGTH. "I didn't think you would come back THAT SOON."

Hjumpik: "Where were you?"

"Field observations."

FIELD OBSERVATIONS. Two words, in a CORRIDOR, from a man with a HIDDEN DOOR BEHIND HIM. Waluigi flags the SENTENCE, not the mushroom: "I didn't think you would come back that soon" is not the language of a man who was somewhere INNOCENT. It is the language of a man who had a WINDOW and MISJUDGED it. The fungus is a DECOY and Waluigi will be FILING on this again.

sections.heading: The House Returned Us To Our Own Doorstep
sections.body:
Hjumpik went back to the mushroom room guard. A SECRET HATCH opened somewhere behind the PANELLING, and the missing colleague came back through it, and they had the *field observations* exchange the archive has ALREADY FILED.

Then Hjumpik asked the only question that MATTERED.

"Why should we TRUST you?"

The guard held up FINGERS. THREE of them. He had them READY, which is ITSELF a FINDING. Waluigi AUDITS readiness. NOBODY has references READY unless they have NEEDED references before, OFTEN, under PRESSURE.

ONE. Aurelian is HELPING.

TWO. Orangus Cornelius.

Three — and here he WARMED UP, and LEANED IN, and became briefly the HERO of his OWN account — "I stopped WARIO. Actually, I did QUITE A BIT."

Let Waluigi take these IN ORDER. The FIRST is a woman currently FOLDED INTO A GOLD RING in Hjumpik's POCKET, who has helped NOBODY in some WEEKS. The SECOND is a NAME the guards of this house have REFUSED to say OUT LOUD since the SITTING ROOM, delivered HERE as a *REFERENCE*. The THIRD is a claim made by a VERY LARGE NUMBER of people, ALMOST ALL of whom are LYING, and NONE of whom have EVER produced a RECEIPT.

The three credentials, AS TRANSCRIBED, are EXHIBITED with the filing. Waluigi EXHIBITS. Waluigi ALWAYS exhibits. Waluigi ESPECIALLY exhibits EVIDENCE THAT CONVICTS ITSELF.

"Fine," said Hjumpik.

The guard knocked THREE TIMES. A door OPENED in a wall that had NO DOOR IN IT.

Waluigi NOTES, WITHOUT COMMENT, that Hjumpik had been GIVEN the instructions FIRST, had TRIED it himself, and had FAILED. THREE KNOCKS. He got it WRONG. The house does not open for people who have been TOLD how; it opens for people it KNOWS. Waluigi's filing, Waluigi's STRUCTURAL note, and Waluigi wants it UNDERLINED: this house has a FUNCTIONING hidden infrastructure that opens for its OWN PEOPLE and returns STRANGERS to where they STARTED — and they have been walking around INSIDE it for WEEKS congratulating THEMSELVES on their STEALTH.

The passage was ONE-BEING-WIDE. They went in SINGLE FILE — wall on BOTH shoulders, the smell of DUST and OLD PLASTER, somebody's lantern throwing their shadows forward in a LONG JOINTED ROW — and they scurried through it with the particular INDIGNITY of important people in a CRAWLSPACE. Waluigi was THERE. Waluigi SCURRIED. Waluigi does not scurry WELL. Waluigi's DIGNITY filed a COMPLAINT.

There were OTHERS in there. WAITING. In the DARK. They did not explain themselves and NOBODY asked.

And then the passage let them out.

Back where they STARTED.

ALL of them. The whole party, the guards, the WAITING figures, out into the same stretch of corridor they had ENTERED from, with the same warm lantern light on the SAME well-cared-for MARBLE.

A secret passage that returns you to your OWN DOORSTEP is NOT a fault in the house. It is the house's OPINION, expressed in ARCHITECTURE, of everyone currently walking around INSIDE it. They have been in this manor for WEEKS and it has decided they are FURNITURE. Waluigi's note. Waluigi's ARCHITECTURE. Waluigi is FURNITURE-PROOF and intends to PROVE IT.

That is when Waluigi STOPPED being able to do this POLITELY.

sections.heading: Waluigi Opened The Door Himself
sections.body:
"You know WHAT," Waluigi said. "We have been going in CIRCLES. And we are *LOSING*."

Hjumpik turned around.

"Look at how many people we have LOST to your INCOMPETENCE," Waluigi said — and Waluigi did not stop, because it had been BUILDING since the marching order and the lost-dog remark and the fungus in the TOILET — "And that Toad too — he just sits around and FOLLOWS you. At least the FEY in this house *CARE* about it."

"We killed one of the BIG plant monsters," Hjumpik said. "Right?"

"A HALF-DEAD one. That was ALMOST KILLED by the fey residents BEFORE we got there."

"Do you want to just run around and FIGHT things," he said, "or THINK before you act?"

And here is where Waluigi wants the archive to SLOW DOWN, because the argument TURNS OVER on this line and Waluigi is the one who TURNED it.

"Thinking has led us THIS FAR," Waluigi said. "We're not dead. But if we DON'T act, they reach the HEIR, and we are STUCK with the plants FOREVER."

"No. NO, no." Hjumpik put a hand out — not at Waluigi, at the CORRIDOR, at the whole GREEN length of it. "We can'T fight every battle. *LOOK at these guys.*"

"I ONE-SHOT that shrub ALMOST ten minutes ago."

"Remember the GOBLINS stabbed it and it DIED." The dwarf's voice went FLAT in a way Waluigi had not heard from him BEFORE. "I don't think that's saying much."

Which was TRUE. Which is EXACTLY the point Waluigi had made HIMSELF, in this same corridor, about this same shrub, and which Waluigi now NEEDED not to be TRUE.

"Then if they're THAT WEAK," Waluigi said, "we should TAKE THEM ON."

And Waluigi OPENED THE DOOR.

Waluigi wants that recorded in the ACTIVE VOICE, because Waluigi has spent this entire filing recording OTHER PEOPLE'S decisions and this ONE WAS WALUIGI'S. NOT the dwarf's. WALUIGI'S. His hand came up as Waluigi reached past him — TOO SLOW, or slow ON PURPOSE, or slow because he had spent the NIGHT being told by Waluigi that THINKING was what was killing them — and it CLOSED on the AIR where Waluigi's sleeve had been.

The monster was standing in the MIDDLE of the room, SURROUNDED by people. It was not half dead. NOTHING about it was half dead. It turned its WHOLE MASS toward the doorway, FOUND them in it, and ROARED — and the sound went through the polished MARBLE and UP into the warm LANTERN LIGHT and OUT into a house that has been keeping its STANDARDS for a THOUSAND YEARS.

Hjumpik looked at WALUIGI. NOT at the thing in the ROOM. At WALUIGI.

"Since WHEN did you care?"

And Waluigi heard Waluigi's SELF answer, in the CORRIDOR, OVER the noise, BEFORE Waluigi had cleared it with ANY part of Waluigi that handles POLICY:

"I can't afford not to care ANYMORE."

The Revel played on DOWNSTAIRS. The filing ends here, in a doorway WALUIGI OPENED, MID-ROAR.

The positions had reversed by the end and never reversed back. Hjumpik counselled restraint and Waluigi forced a fight, and the archive records both facts without flinching. The library is held by no one; the reclamation is a sentence in this filing rather than a fact on the ground. What changed was volume eleven, and a finger under the line.

RECOMMENDATION: NONE. There is no recommendation. The violet fungus is UNCATALOGUED and UNTRANSLATED. The circular passage has NOT been RE-ENTERED. The standing order — UPSTAIRS, the main room, the HEIR, the plan built on a tactical map over a WHOLE NIGHT — has now been abandoned for a FULL SESSION and replaced with NOTHING. Next filing begins in that DOORWAY, and it is WALUIGI'S.

WAH.
